test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The storm last night uprooted a large number of trees.

options.text: A large number of trees have been uprooted by the storm last night.
The storm last night was uprooted by a large number of trees.
A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm last night.
A large number of trees uprooted the storm last night.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm last night.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Past Tense and Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Past Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Structure__: Subject + V2 + object __(Active Voice)__

 Object + was/were + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) __(Passive Voice)__ 
 __
 
• Example: *Disha arranged the things. *(Active Voice)

 * The things were arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm last night.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Simple Past Tense और Active Voice में है।
 
• Simple Past Tense को Active voice से Passive voice में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का Object, Passive Voice का Subject बन जाता है।
 
• संरचना__: Subject + V2 + object __(Active Voice)__

 Object + was/were + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
• Example: *Disha arranged the things. *(Active Voice)

 * The things were arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
